thread:
samir: quick flag from today's onboarding session: our README tells new devs to copy REDWOOD_API_KEY into .env. half the time they actually need a project token and CI explodes later. we need a migration shim in sample apps.

flo: agreed. what's the smallest safe shim? a script that checks for REDWOOD_API_KEY and prompts to copy to REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY if missing?

flo: proposal: docker-entrypoint checks envs at startup, if REDWOOD_API_KEY exists and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY is empty then set REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=REDWOOD_API_KEY for the process and log a one-time WARN that legacy var used and suggest migrating.

anya: that sounds safe. make sure we redact values in logs. also add a `--migrate-legacy-keys` flag in sample app so maintainers can opt-in during transition.

cli-team: we should also add `rw whoami --print-env` that prints which env var is active (name only), so CI owners can quickly see what secret is wired. CLI will not print values.

infra: for k8s, we can include a Helm hook that maps legacy key names to new keys in the secret and emits a note during deployment. we'll coordinate a 2-week window where both names are accepted.

samir: rotation guidance: docs should show atomic rotate steps: 1) write new secret key to secret with both `redwood.project_key` and legacy `redwood.api_key` populated, 2) do a rolling restart or use sidecar hot-swap, 3) after stable, remove legacy key. include kubectl/helm examples.

flo: GH Actions pattern: use per-run ephemeral token if possible. if not, store project-scoped token in repo secrets named REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. provide an actions wrapper `redwood/setup-token` that can optionally read legacy secret and warn.

anya: small SDK change: make precedence explicit and testable: read order = REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, REDWOOD_CLI_EPHEMERAL, REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy). but add a one-time telemetry ping and a startup warn when legacy var used while project var absent.

cli-team: will add `rw auth status --show-scope` too. also adding a `--rotate` helper to call the platform rotate endpoint and update local env/migrator script.

doc-bot: Reminder: open RFC "legacy env var shim + migration plan" and add checklist for sample app PRs (shim, README, CI example, k8s helm mapping).

infra: we'll put a short migration runbook in docs: how to update secrets in-place via `kubectl patch secret` and Helm notes for common providers. include a Canary flow to validate new token before deleting legacy one.

flo: i'll prepare a tiny bash shim and a Dockerfile snippet for sample apps and open PR. will gate behind feature flag until we update all official samples.

anya: tests: add CI job that runs sample app with three env combinations to ensure shim behaves: only legacy set, only project set, both set. assert warning emitted only when legacy used.

samir: thanks. once PRs land let's flip the flag and remove shim after 30 days. closing when docs + shim + CLI whoami landed. :white_check_mark:
